newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hero Honda up three pct on BSE.
newsitem.headline: India's Hero Honda up three pct on BSE.

text.p: Shares of Indian two-wheeler maker Hero Honda jumped 16 rupees, or three percent, to 526 in early trade on the Bombay bourse on Tuesday, traders said.
They said funds and speculators were buyers in the stock after the firm recently announced improved results for the year ended March 31.
Hero Honda said its net profit surged to 503.6 million rupees in 1996/97, from 263.4 million in the previous years.
An analyst at a foreign broking firm said Hero Honda's April motorcycle sales had registered a smart 41 percent year-on-year growth to 20,737 units, against a segment growth of 19 percent.
"The company is likely to increase its dominance to the number one position in the motorcycle segment," the analyst said. "I expect it to be the number one player in motorcycles by next year."
Bajaj Auto currently has a market share of around 31 percent in the motorcycle market, followed by Hero Honda with a share of around 27.5 percent, the analyst said.
